children.name: Article Lead
children.text: Extend the per-game sidecar while keeping its authenticated contract, filesystem boundary, and capabilities explicit.

children.name: Article Callout Text
children.text: Unsupported capabilities must disappear or degrade safely—not emit a request that cannot succeed.

children.name: Section Body 1
children.text: The sidecar serves authenticated operational endpoints with health and metrics as narrow unauthenticated exceptions.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 0
children.text: Surface includes files, logs, console, players, mods, status, actions, hooks.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 1
children.text: Production uses operator-managed mTLS; bearer is compatibility-only.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 2
children.text: File operations are rooted at /data, bounded, and traversal-safe.

children.name: Section Body 2
children.text: Adapters normalize RCON, PTY, log files, moderation, status, and graceful stop across games.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 0
children.text: Separate authoritative game logs from container stdout.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 1
children.text: Model console mode and credentials without hard-coding secrets; a console with no password sets spec.rcon.authentication: false (v0.4.0).

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 2
children.text: Capability gates hide unsupported status, players, actions, and mods.

children.name: Section Body 3
children.text: Update OpenAPI, handlers, API proxy, safety libraries, and protocol tests as one wire-contract change.
